about: In-match chat (src/Patches/ChatHud.cs): the quick chat wheel's lines, the emote wheel, and timings. A wheel shows its rows clockwise from the top (the first row is up). Typed chat has no rows: settings.max_length limits a line. Generates Chat in src/Generated/Sheets.g.cs.

columns.id: stable key (sent online by its index in this sheet, per kind)
columns.text: what the bubble says (quick) or the emote's symbol (emote)
columns.label: the wheel's label
columns.color: hex colour of the bubble's text
columns.verified: how it was seen in game, or 'no'
